test_safety_and_scope.fixtures: Ephemeral Ed25519 key pair generated in memory; synthetic review.example issuer and local claims.
test_safety_and_scope.environment: env -i test VMs; only test-process environment changed. No production secret read or live configuration edit.
test_safety_and_scope.network: No listener, package download or network operation in the test harness. No packet-capture or namespace-isolation claim; unshare -Urn was unavailable.
test_safety_and_scope.mutation_paths: Known POST paths were called only after actual wrapper plus harmless unknown-route rejection checks passed, using a rejected credential; all returned 401 before their mutation handlers.
excluded: production IdP configuration or JWKS fetch
test_safety_and_scope.scope_flags_basis: external_traffic and production_secret_access booleans are harness-design assertions, not separate measured monitors.

correspondence.requirement: Only the fixed EdDSA/Ed25519 profile verifies signatures against operator-supplied public keys.
correspondence.evidence: Real crypto positive/wrong-key/tamper controls; header allowlist, strict canonical base64url, duplicate JSON rejection, bounded JWT/JWKS.

correspondence.requirement: Subject, issuer, audience and time predicates all follow verified signature.
correspondence.evidence: Exact issuer, audience shape/membership, exp strict boundary, nbf/iat skew and ordering, subject shape controls.

correspondence.requirement: Snapshot absence, future timestamp and expiry reject.
Selected OIDC mode never falls back to legacy static admin.
correspondence.evidence: Tampered JWT set equal to synthetic C3I_API_TOKEN still rejected in OIDC mode; missing/stale snapshots also rejected; get_authenticated_user rejects.

correspondence.requirement: The real request router rejects bad credentials before intended POST handlers.
correspondence.evidence: 16 known POST paths returned 401. Valid unknown POST returned 404; unsupported PUT/DELETE/PATCH returned 405.

correspondence.requirement: The actual web entrypoint routes request metadata through authentication and method handling.
correspondence.evidence: AG-UI and API fallback call path-only route; no handle_request boundary.

findings.problem: AG-UI and API fallback pass only path to c3i_router.route, discarding request method, headers and body; responses are rebuilt with status 200. This bypasses handle_request and authenticated handle_post.
findings.concrete_effect: /api/v1/reload reaches the path router's side-effecting reload function when the request health guard permits. Other POST-only handlers are not automatically reachable through this path; many instead yield unknown-route output.
findings.requested_fix: Adapt the actual Mist request into the authenticated request router, preserving method/headers/body and response status/headers. Test through the exported adapter boundary; keep mutation rejection ahead of handlers.

findings.problem: The path route maps /api/v1/reload to hot_reload.reload_changed; is_post_only_path omits it. GET/HEAD handling can therefore invoke reload without the POST auth boundary.
findings.requested_fix: Make GET/HEAD metadata-only or 405 and keep the reload effect exclusively behind authenticated POST. Update the POST-only registry and route-level negative tests.
findings.runtime_reproduction: NOT_EXECUTED; no reload invoked by this lane.

operational_limits: FERRISKEY_ENABLED must explicitly equal true or 1; absent or other values select the legacy static mode. Missing C3I_API_TOKEN in static mode retains the existing c3i-dev-token fallback.
Operator must provision the intended issuer, audience and client values; development defaults remain.
Operator must provide trustworthy public JWKS plus loaded-at and maximum-age metadata and refresh them externally. Request handling performs no discovery or refresh.
Snapshot age defaults to 300 seconds with an implementation maximum of 3600 seconds; future or expired snapshots reject.
Only the strict EdDSA/Ed25519 JWT profile is reviewed. This is not general JOSE/OIDC compatibility, deployment validation or a formal proof of the implementation.
Authentication of a request is not per-route authorization: this candidate does not add a complete RBAC/MFA endpoint policy.
Live indrajaal ingress was reviewed from frozen source only; no listener or operational authentication configuration was interrogated.
preexisting_findings_evidence: Both router.gleam and indrajaal_gleam_web.gleam have identical SHA-256 in the candidate and its immediate parent, verified with jj file show.
